mission: Concordia AI is a Beijing-based social enterprise that advances AI safety in China and between China and the rest of the world. It advises Chinese policymakers and AI labs, supports Chinese technical safety researchers, hosts safety forums at major Chinese AI conferences, and publishes the 'AI Safety in China' newsletter and annual State of AI Safety reports.

key_work.title: State of AI Safety in China (2026)
key_work.plain_summary: An annual report on China's AI safety governance, technical research, industry practice and expert views — a key source for outsiders.

key_work.title: Frontier AI Risk Management Framework 2.0
key_work.plain_summary: A framework (developed with Chinese partners) for identifying, evaluating and mitigating severe risks from general-purpose AI models.

key_work.title: Frontier Open-Weight AI Risk Management Framework
key_work.plain_summary: Guidance specifically for managing risks of openly released model weights.

key_work.title: Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities 2026
key_work.plain_summary: The outcome of an international scientific exchange (100+ contributors, 13 countries), including principles for managing risks of AI agents.

key_work.title: State of AI Safety in Singapore (2026)
key_work.plain_summary: A companion report on Singapore's AI safety ecosystem and governance.

status_raw: active — certified social enterprise in Beijing (2023)
funding_note: Revenue mainly from consulting; states it received no government or corporate money for its State of AI Safety reports.
size_note: 12 full-time staff and 25+ affiliates (Brian Tse, LinkedIn)

warnings.text: Rapid AI progress raises critical questions for all societies; frontier risks need global governance.
Open-weight frontier models create distinct risks that need their own management.
AI combined with life sciences could create biological risks requiring safeguards.

recommendations.text: Build trust and dialogue between Chinese and international AI safety communities.
Adopt structured frontier AI risk-management frameworks in industry.
Grow the technical AI safety research community in China.
